rules: Fundamental CS_RANK crossed multiplicatively with TS_RANK of a price/volume statistic (range, dollar_volume, or its dispersion) produced this round's top 3 fitnesses (3.60, 2.89, 2.20) — extend this template to untried fundamental/window combos before reaching for a CS_ZSCORE-based fusion.

TS_CORR/TS_COV between $return and $volume fails the cheap screen regardless of transform — raw, SIGN, and ABS variants all scored |t| 0.36-0.71 this round. Don't propose return-volume co-movement statistics directly; rank one leg first or drop the raw return leg.

A 1-day TS_DELTA on a fundamental (e.g. $roe) fails the coverage gate (0.784-0.786) even though that fundamental's level is normally reliable. Treat short-window fundamental deltas as a coverage risk, not just a signal-flatness risk.

Swapping $volume for $dollar_volume doesn't decorrelate even when buried inside a larger fusion (rho 0.986 under a CS_RANK*TS_RANK wrapper) or when only the denominator's statistic changes (rho 0.919, raw dollar_volume vs its own TS_STD). Check the archive under both fields before submitting either.

Changing only the outer time-series statistic (e.g. TS_STD vs TS_MEAN) on an otherwise-identical guarded ratio still collides on archive_subtree (7 shared nodes this round) — the inner expression needs to change too, not just the outer wrapper.

The 'difference of two CS_RANK((high-low)/(X+eps))' family with a 5-day normalizer window is archive-saturated — two independent proposals this round shared 5 and 10 nodes with existing accepts. Retire this exact shape or move to a materially longer window.

Of all $return-based cheap_screen rejects this round, a 40-day return sum normalized by 21-day range came closest to clearing (|t| 0.82) — a decayed or reweighted version of that specific pairing is worth one more try before dropping return-sum-over-range ideas entirely.

Several within-round duplicates reused the same 5-day dollar_volume/range ratio and the same-length roa/roe delta shape — vary window length or operator before resubmitting a shape already tried earlier in the same run.
